segments.text: So today we're going to turn our focus from experts working on the front lines to interesting clinical trials being done in the world of gastroenterology.
Today's guest, Dr. Julia Schneider, is heading up such a trial, the aim of which is the effectiveness of two different dietary interventions for patients with Crohn's disease.
Please welcome Dr. Schneider to the program.
